metaTitle: Book an appointment | The Hague Natural Health Centre
metaDescription: Choose a treatment, a therapist and a time, and book straight away.

unavailable.title: Online booking is not available right now
unavailable.text: Please try again in a moment, or contact us and we will help you book.

choose.title: Book an appointment
choose.intro: Choose a treatment. You pick a time on the next screen.
choose.depositFull: {deposit} paid in full when you book
choose.emptyText: No treatments can be booked online at the moment. Please contact us and we will help you.
choose.notFoundText: This therapist or therapy can't be booked online right now. Have a look at all treatments instead.

time.title: Choose a time
time.intro: Days with a dot still have space. Times are in The Hague time.
time.takenText: Sorry, that time was booked a moment ago. Your name and contact details are saved. Please choose another time.
time.noneText: Try the next week. New times are added regularly.

summary.title: Your appointment
summary.balanceNote: You pay the rest at the session, in cash, by card or Tikkie.
summary.hold: We hold your time for 15 minutes while you book.

details.title: Your details
details.intro: Only your therapist sees what you write about your health.
details.signedInAs: Signed in as {name}. We filled in your details.
details.phoneHint: Only used if your therapist needs to reach you about this appointment.
details.reasonPlaceholder: For example: digestive complaint, chronic pain, general relaxation…
details.clientKind: Have you seen this therapist before?
details.clientNew: No, this is my first visit
details.comments: Anything else your therapist should know?
details.policyNone: Cancel at least 24 hours before your appointment and you get your deposit back.
details.healthConsent: I agree that my therapist may store and use the health information I give here to treat me
details.healthConsentHint: Only your therapist can read it. The centre's staff cannot. You can ask for it to be deleted at any time.
details.slotGoneText: Sorry, that time was booked a moment ago. Please choose another time.
details.errorSummary: Please check the fields marked below.
details.genericError: Something went wrong on our side. Your details are still here. Please try again.

errors.emailFormat: This email address doesn't look right. Check for typos, for example name@example.com.
errors.phoneFormat: This phone number doesn't look right. Use digits only, for example 06 12345678.
errors.reason: Please tell your therapist briefly why you are coming.
errors.dateOfBirth: Please enter a date in the past.
errors.tooLong: This is too long. Please shorten it.
errors.acceptedPolicy: Please accept the cancellation policy to continue.
errors.healthDataConsent: We need your consent to pass your health information to your therapist.

details.fromAccount: These come from your account. You can change them there.

pay.title: Pay your deposit
pay.intro: Your deposit secures the appointment. You pay the rest at the session.
pay.demoText: This is a practice version of the payment step. In the live site you pay with iDEAL at your own bank.
pay.holdLeft: We hold this time for you for another {time}
pay.expiredTitle: Your time is no longer held
pay.expiredText: The 15 minutes to pay have passed, so the time was released. Nothing was charged. Please choose a time again.
pay.failedTitle: The payment did not go through
pay.failedText: No money was taken. You can try again while we still hold your time.
pay.failedReleasedText: No money was taken and the time was released. Please choose a time again.
pay.abandonedText: No money was taken and the time was released. Please choose a time again.
pay.errorText: No money was taken. Please try again.

confirmed.title: Your appointment is booked
confirmed.intro: Thank you, {name}. We look forward to seeing you.
confirmed.introNoName: Thank you. We look forward to seeing you.
confirmed.emailNote: We have sent the details to your email address.
confirmed.next1: You receive a confirmation email with your deposit receipt.
confirmed.next2: {name} receives your details and prepares for your visit.
confirmed.next3: We send you a reminder {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} before your appointment.
confirmed.next4: You pay the remaining {balance} at the session.

account.metaTitle: My appointments | The Hague Natural Health Centre
account.title: My appointments
account.emptyText: When you book an appointment, you will find it here.
account.cancelOnTime: You are cancelling in time, so your deposit of {deposit} is refunded.
account.cancelLate: This is less than {notice} before your appointment. Under {name}'s cancellation policy part or all of your deposit may be kept.
account.noticeDays: {n, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}}
account.cancelError: We couldn't cancel this appointment. Please try again or contact your therapist.
account.notReadyTitle: Your appointments will appear here soon
account.notReadyText: The client area is still being connected. Your bookings are safe; contact your therapist if you need to change one.
account.refundFull: {refund} of your deposit is refunded to you.
account.refundPartial: {refund} of your deposit is refunded to you; {fee} is kept as a cancellation fee.
account.refundNone: Under the cancellation policy the deposit of {fee} is kept.
account.refundNothingPaid: No deposit had been paid, so nothing is refunded.
